title: Paper v2 (1/2): one set of scripts for both versions — --inputs, inputs-v1.json, strict title parser, byte-for-byte v1 proof
description:
Piece 1 of 2 of **LIN-4331** (Paper v2: *Can a task finish with the codebase cleaner than it started?*). Scripts only: no paper edits, no v2 evidence folder. Lands first; LIN-4331's second subtask (v2 evidence and paper) builds on it.

**Start from the parent's approved plan.** It is in LIN-4331's description, under "Implementation Plan" (Decisions 4 and 5, "Ways it breaks" 1–2, "Order of landing", Session 1), with the plan-review notes in comment `f6be0443-c484-4589-bd0c-c54ac2aee667`. Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4331.

## This piece's slice of the approved plan

**Files** (LinearViewer, `docs/papers/harbour/cleaner-than-it-started-scripts/`):

* `freeze.mjs`, `code-blind.mjs`, `analyse.mjs`, `census-by-merge.mjs`: parameterise them with `--inputs <file>`.
* New `inputs-v1.json` in the **scripts** folder, not in v1's evidence folder. v1's folder `cleaner-than-it-started-evidence/2026-11-06/` must stay byte-identical. Say why in the script header.
* A new `node:test` file beside the scripts for the parser. It is run by hand; wiring it into CI is out of scope.

**Implemented** (pruned at close-out; the plan's Approach and Testing strategy sections are preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail): PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2337](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2337>), merged as `509f797e`. Implemented as approved: one script set, `--inputs` on all four scripts, `inputs-v1.json` in the scripts folder, strict three-shape title parser, freeze contract/truncation/cutoff checks, and inputs-gated v2 hooks. Deviation: a shared `inputs.mjs` reader was added. The v1 byte-for-byte witness (`blind-codes.json`, `analysis.json`, `evidence-table.tsv`, separate-copy `census-by-merge.json`) was cmp-identical at the merged head.

## Acceptance

* All four scripts take `--inputs`, and `inputs-v1.json` exists in the scripts folder.
* The byte-for-byte v1 witness passes and the output is pasted in the PR.
* The parser test passes.
* v1's evidence folder is unchanged.
* The paper is unchanged.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4331's approving plan-review (comment f6be0443-c484-4589-bd0c-c54ac2aee667, rev 1)

Grounding commits: LinearViewer `1c894016` (main, the plan's pin; re-checked unchanged at breakdown, 6 Nov 13:1xZ); v1 paper and scripts at `5c63aa26`; v1 pin `1d10f9b3`; simple-dispatcher `07c88f7`.

comments.body:
Beat 1/4 done on branch `feat/lin-4333-scripts-inputs`, commit `8f7816f2` (LinearViewer). PR not opened.

- Shared `--inputs <file>` reader in `inputs.mjs`; all four scripts take it (required). v1 data moved to `inputs-v1.json` in the scripts folder, with the reason in `inputs.mjs`.
- Witness, on scratch copies: `code-blind` + `analyse` with `inputs-v1.json` reproduce `blind-codes.json`, `analysis.json`, `evidence-table.tsv` byte-identically (cmp against v1 and against the pre-change run); `census-by-merge` (separate copy) reproduces `git/census-by-merge.json` byte-identically. v1 evidence folder: git status clean.
- `freeze.mjs` cannot be re-run live as v1: LIN-4150 now has 62 blind passes, so the 42-pass assertion stops it before any write (same before and after the change).
- Not in this beat (left for later beats): title parser, freeze truncation check, pair-baseline handling, the frozen Oct merge list hook.

Beat 2/4 done on `feat/lin-4333-scripts-inputs`, commit `289525e9`. PR not opened.

- Strict `parseTitle()` in code-blind.mjs: three shapes (batch X; tickets pass ID with LIN- on the first token only; baseline pair N pass ID with no ticket). Anything else throws naming the title. Importing has no side effects.
- Before: "baseline pair 1 pass AW" coded as LIN-1; "LIN-4248 pass E pass F" silently coded as pass F.
- title-parser.test.mjs (manual only, not in the unit globs): 9 tests, all pass. Mutant with the old lenient rule: 3 tests fail.
- v1 witness on scratch: blind-codes.json, analysis.json, evidence-table.tsv cmp identical. Evidence folder hashes unchanged.
- Oct merge list hook: not present in code-blind (grep: no Oct / 2026-10 references). Needed for pair-baseline label resolution, so it belongs with the pair-baseline beat; not added here.

Beat 3/4 done on `feat/lin-4333-scripts-inputs`, commit `76868ab9`. PR not opened.

- freeze.mjs: GET /instructions checked against the documented contract lines before any write; truncated.comments === true stops it (no count of 50); optional blind.comment_cutoff keeps raw comments and excludes them from counts; optional oct_merges writes the Oct list.
- analyse.mjs: pair-baseline passes routed out before the subjects loop; refused by name if no pair_baseline section is named; the section is emitted only when named.
- code-blind.mjs: cutoff filter; Oct list loaded only when oct_merges is named.
- Tests (manual): freeze.test.mjs 9/9 against a stub API; analyse.test.mjs 3/3. Each new behaviour checked by injecting a defect; the matching test fails.
- v1 witness: cmp identical; evidence folder unchanged. Live v1 freeze still stops at the 42-pass assertion (live LIN-4150 has 62).
- Live /instructions passes the contract check.

Beat 4/4 done. PR open, not merged: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2337 (head 76868ab9, base main). CI green on that head: run https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/actions/runs/42226096887 (Unit tests, Secret scan, E2E shards 1-4, CI success: all pass).

Final v1 witness from a clean worktree of 76868ab9: code-blind, analyse and census-by-merge (census on its own copy) reproduce blind-codes.json, analysis.json, evidence-table.tsv and git/census-by-merge.json byte-identically (cmp). Evidence folder: git status clean; git diff main...HEAD shows nothing under the evidence folder.

Tests: 20/20 manual node:test cases pass (title-parser 9, freeze 8, analyse 3). Full npm run test:unit: 23947 tests, 0 failed, exit 0. The manual files are outside every CI glob.

Live v1 freeze can no longer be re-run (LIN-4150 has 62 blind passes); v1 is proved by the pinned re-derivation. Design choices and ambiguities are listed in the PR description.

## Review — LIN-4333

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2337, reviewed at head `76868ab9` (base `main` @ `1c894016`). I checked it independently in a clean worktree of that head.

CI: green on `76868ab9` (run 42226096887: Unit tests, Secret scan, E2E 1–4, CI success). That run does not touch this deliverable. No CI glob reaches `docs/papers/`, so every check below I ran myself.

### Scope vs plan
The PR changes exactly the places the plan named: the four scripts, the new `inputs.mjs` + `inputs-v1.json` in the scripts folder, and three manual `node:test` files. `git diff origin/main...HEAD` has nothing under `cleaner-than-it-started-evidence/` and nothing in `cleaner-than-it-started.md`. Adding the shared `inputs.mjs` is a reasonable small extension of the plan, and its header gives the reason v1's inputs live outside the evidence folder. Staleness: no commits to `docs/papers/harbour/` on main since the ticket was created. Regression: the only earlier commit on these files is `5c63aa26` (v1 creation), so no prior fix or revert could be re-introduced.

### Independent checks (all at 76868ab9)
- **v1 byte-for-byte:** two fresh copies of the v1 folder.
  - Copy A ran `code-blind` → `analyse` with `--inputs inputs-v1.json` and printed `coded 42 passes, 94 rows, unresolved labels: 0` / `rows 90; place 62; unclassified 0; subjects 19`. `blind-codes.json`, `analysis.json` and `evidence-table.tsv` are cmp IDENTICAL, and `diff -r` of the whole folder against the committed one is clean.
  - Copy B ran `census-by-merge` on its own, and `git/census-by-merge.json` is IDENTICAL.
- **Freeze-only inputs**, which the witness cannot reach: I compared each one with the constants it replaced in `main:freeze.mjs`. Pins, `WINDOW_START`, `PARENTS`, `BASELINE_3NOV`, `UI_FOUR`, `FOLDED`, `CONTEXT`, the 42 passes, A–D and the 3 Nov window/file are all equal. `merges-LinearViewer.tsv` and `merges-LinearViewer-2026-11-02-03.tsv` re-derive byte-identically from `1d10f9b3`.
- **Manual tests:** title-parser 9/9, freeze 8/8, analyse 3/3, all pass.
- **Mutation check (LIN-2274):** each mutation below turned its test red, and every mutation was reverted afterwards (tree clean).

  | Mutation | Failing tests |
  |---|---|
  | Drop the `baseline pair` shape | 2 |
  | Old lenient `(.*?) pass` ticket rule | 3 |
  | Remove `assertNotTruncated` | 1 |
  | Remove `checkInstructions` | 1 |
  | Freeze ignores the cutoff | 2 |
  | code-blind never loads the Oct list | 1 |
  | analyse drops the pair refusal | 1 |
  | analyse doesn't route pair passes out | 2 |

- **Live `GET /instructions`:** passes `checkInstructions`.
- **Oct `diff-tree -m --first-parent`:** the test fixture has no merge commits, so I checked the two real merge commits in the 20 Oct–1 Nov window at `1d10f9b3` (`3907c211`, `7776bd23`). Each file list equals `git diff $h^1 $h`, with 34 and 138 files.
- **No `--inputs`:** prints the usage line and exits 2.

### Class check
The class is v1 constants hard-coded in the scripts. What remains is intentional: output key names such as `tickets_with_survey_on_LIN_4150`, `linear_150_comments`, `census.at_af55cb73` and the `blind-codes.json` `source` string. Renaming them would break v1 bytes. They are correct for v2 too, because the blind ticket is still LIN-4150.

The ticket names four v2 sections. Only `pair_baseline` exists, and it is gated. The Survey recount, `v1_vs_v2` and the post-`af55cb73` list don't exist yet, so v1 can't emit them. LIN-4334 must add each one behind its own inputs key in the same way. This goes to LIN-4334, not here.

Sibling found: the user-facing re-run commands (below).

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside, not yet discharged:** v1's documented re-run commands no longer work as written. `cleaner-than-it-started-evidence/2026-11-06/README.md:51-54` lists the four commands without `--inputs`, and each now exits 2 with usage. The failure is loud, not silent. That README must stay byte-identical, so the fix goes in the scripts folder.
  - **Close-out fix, before merge:** in the `inputs.mjs` header, add a line saying the v1 README's "Re-run" commands predate `--inputs`. They need `--inputs docs/papers/harbour/cleaner-than-it-started-scripts/inputs-v1.json` appended, and `census-by-merge` should run on a separate copy.
  - **Check:** `grep -n "Re-run" inputs.mjs` finds the line, and the v1 witness still passes, since a comment can't change any output.
  - The v2 paper's own command lines belong to LIN-4334.
- **Inside, discharged:** the byte-for-byte v1 witness. I re-ran it independently at `76868ab9`. Its limit: it is not a clean CI environment, and it covers no commit after `76868ab9`. Close-out should re-run it if the head moves.
- **Inside, discharged:** the 20 manual tests, which are outside CI by design. I re-ran them and mutation-checked them at `76868ab9`.
- **Inside, partly dischargeable:** freeze's live API path (`/issues`, `/cost`, `/dispatch`, `/prompt` and the truncation flag on real bodies). Only a stub covers it, because the live v1 freeze stops at the 42-pass assertion (LIN-4150 now has 62).
  - I discharged the inputs side and the `/instructions` contract against live.
  - The rest is settled after the deploy: LIN-4334's v2 freeze is the first live run, and it fails loudly on a contract change, truncation or a count mismatch.
  - **Rollback:** revert PR #2337. Nothing is persisted in a new shape.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. Everything the ticket accepts on is met and independently re-verified: `--inputs` on all four scripts, `inputs-v1.json` in the scripts folder, the cmp-identical v1 witness, parser tests that pass and go red under mutation, the evidence folder unchanged and the paper unchanged. Close-out's one fix is the `inputs.mjs` header line about the README's re-run commands. Nothing needs re-design.

## Close-out — LIN-4333

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2337, squash commit `509f797e`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 50eea574`. The review (Approve at `76868ab9`, conditional on the ledger) was my authority.

**Change I made after approval** (one commit, `50eea574`): the `inputs.mjs` header now says the v1 README's "Re-run" commands (`README.md:51-54`) predate `--inputs`. They need `--inputs docs/papers/harbour/cleaner-than-it-started-scripts/inputs-v1.json` appended, and `census-by-merge` should run on a separate copy. This answers the review's one inside item. It is a comment only, and the v1 evidence README stays byte-identical. `grep -n "Re-run" inputs.mjs` finds it at line 11.

**CI:** this repo has CI. Run https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/actions/runs/42227655404 on `50eea574`: Unit tests, Secret scan, E2E shards 1-4 and CI success all pass. The merged tree under `docs/papers` equals the head.

**Ledger**
- v1 byte-for-byte witness (inside): re-run on scratch copies at `50eea574`. `code-blind` + `analyse` print `coded 42 passes, 94 rows, unresolved labels: 0` / `rows 90; place 62; unclassified 0; subjects 19`. `blind-codes.json`, `analysis.json` and `evidence-table.tsv` are cmp IDENTICAL. `census-by-merge`, run on a separate copy, prints `census recorded at 62 merges`, and `git/census-by-merge.json` is IDENTICAL. The evidence folder and the paper are untouched by the PR.
- 20 manual node:test cases (inside): 20/20 pass at `50eea574` (re-run after the comment edit). The review's mutation check at `76868ab9` covers them, and the change since is a comment.
- Freeze's live API path (inside, partly dischargeable): no deploy is involved, because this is scripts and docs only. The live v1 freeze cannot run (LIN-4150 has 62 blind passes against the 42 asserted). The first live run is LIN-4334's v2 freeze, which fails loudly on a contract change, truncation or a count mismatch. **Not run:** a live freeze against real `/issues`, `/cost`, `/dispatch`, `/prompt` bodies. It is not runnable until LIN-4334 supplies v2 inputs, and the operator who can run it is whoever works LIN-4334. Only a stub and the live `/instructions` contract check (done by review) cover it.
- Rollback (named by review): revert PR #2337. Nothing is persisted in a new shape.
- Outside: the review sent the v2 sections (Survey recount, `v1_vs_v2`, post-`af55cb73` list) to LIN-4334. Each goes behind its own inputs key, as `pair_baseline` already is. I added that to LIN-4334 as a comment, an existing ticket, so I filed no new follow-up.

**Related tickets:** LIN-4334 is unblocked and still Todo. LIN-4331 stays open for LIN-4334.

**Description:** the pre-prune description is archived in the task snapshots (verified, 3 snapshots). I replaced the Approach and Testing-strategy sections with an implemented stub. Files, Acceptance, the session-fit line and the plan-review line are kept word for word.

## Autopilot run summary — LIN-4333 (stepper, one warm implementation session, then review and close-out)

**Result:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2337 merged (squash `509f797e`), LIN-4333 Done.

**Beats (one warm worker session, ROOT `70d30d5a`):**
1. 1/4 `8f7816f2`: shared `--inputs` reader (`inputs.mjs`), `inputs-v1.json`, all four scripts parameterised. v1 baseline captured first.
2. 2/4 `289525e9`: strict three-shape `parseTitle()` in `code-blind.mjs` + manual `title-parser.test.mjs` (mutant check: 3 tests fail on the old lenient rule).
3. 3/4 `76868ab9`: `freeze.mjs` (`/instructions` shape check, `truncated.comments` stop, optional cutoff), `analyse.mjs` pair-baseline routing, inputs-gated Oct merge list. 20 manual tests in total.
4. 4/4: fresh-worktree v1 witness, PR opened, CI green.
Then a fresh `review` (Approve, conditional on one inside item) and a `close-out` (comment-only commit `50eea574`, merge, Done).

**Evidence I checked myself (not worker claims):** every beat's commit existed and touched only the scripts folder; the 20 manual tests pass (9/9, then 20/20 on my own run); `git diff` shows nothing under `cleaner-than-it-started-evidence/`; PR head `50eea574` has CI green (Unit tests, E2E 1-4, Secret scan, CI success); the fix commit is +7 comment lines in `inputs.mjs`. The review independently re-ran the v1 `cmp` witness (identical) and 8 mutation checks.

**What holds:** one script set serves v1 and v2 via `--inputs`; v1 output reproduces byte-for-byte; the title parser rejects unknown/ambiguous/stray-number titles; freeze fails loudly instead of guessing.

**What's left / not proven:** (a) the post-merge CI run on `main` at `509f797e` was still in progress when I wrapped up; the same tree passed on the PR head. (b) Freeze's live API path is only covered by a stub plus the live `/instructions` contract check; the first real run is LIN-4334's v2 freeze. (c) LIN-4334 must add the other three v2 sections (Survey recount, `v1_vs_v2`, post-`af55cb73` list) behind their own inputs keys. (d) Ambiguities for LIN-4334 to settle: `oct_merges.until` is exclusive (2 Nov) vs the plan's "1 Nov end"; `pair_baseline` fields are not defined by the plan. Rollback: revert PR #2337.
